summary.zh: 给自媒体一键生成科普漫画：选题理解、事实核查、分镜脚本、角色卡锚定跨格一致性，逐格产出可发布的漫画图片。
summary.en: One-click science comics for content creators: topic analysis, fact-checking, storyboard scripting, character-card anchoring for cross-panel consistency, and panel-by-panel publishable comic images.

summary.zh: 帮助普通人写个人传记的 Agent Skill：访谈式采集回忆，自动整理时间线并章节化成稿；访谈中适时引导提供老照片，没有照片时可配明确标注的 AI 示意插图。会聊天就能写传记。
summary.en: An Agent Skill that helps ordinary people write their biography: interview-style memory collection, automatic timeline organization, chapter-based drafting, photo collection with clearly-labeled AI illustration fallback — if you can chat, you can write your life story.

summary.en: Design a family menu that's truly your own: records tastes, restrictions, and cooking skill; generates weekly balanced home-cooking menus with shopping lists that evolve with your feedback.

summary.zh: 从一句情绪描述到一首完整的歌：AI 一条龙生成歌词（含中文韵脚库与发音校正）、曲风提示词（16 套流派模板）、MV 概念、分镜脚本、首尾帧与视频提示词；装有 Suno CLI 时可端到端直接产出成品。
summary.en: From a single emotion to a complete song: an end-to-end AI pipeline generating lyrics (with a Chinese rhyme library and pronunciation guard), style prompts (16 genre templates), MV concept, storyboard, and first/last-frame video prompts — with optional local generation of actual audio and video.
